narr: Several rounds of severe thunderstorms tracked along a warm front over southern WI from the afternoon of July 23rd into the early morning hours of July 24th. Numerous reports of wind damage were received. Destructive, large hail and flash flooding also occurred.
ev: Flash flooding of streets including a flooded Green Bay Road after a quick 2-2.5 inches of rainfall.
lsr: REPORT FROM MPING: STREET/ROAD FLOODING; STREET/ROAD CLOSED; VEHICLES STRANDED.
